disclaimer: Curated from the provided report. Access terms, licences and versions must be re-checked at the source before use. This is not medical advice and not a clinical decision tool.

datasets.name: CEDAR
datasets.labels: Curated positive and negative T-cell, B-cell, MHC-ligand and TCR/antibody receptor assays
datasets.scale: 445,931 epitopes · 26 cancer types · 6,203 publications · 1.41M positive and 115,659 negative assays
datasets.access: Open — web portal, database export and query API
datasets.recommended_question: Which assay-defined epitopes survive a group-aware ranking against a binding-only baseline?
datasets.notes: Best first stop for pan-cancer immunogenicity labels. Pair with CEDAR Next-Generation Tools (MPG, PHBR, PEPMatch, AXEL-F).

datasets.name: IEDB
datasets.labels: Positive and negative experimental T-cell, B-cell, MHC-ligand and receptor recognition assays
datasets.scale: 1,702,708 peptidic epitopes · 158,169 T-cell assays · 148,228 B-cell assays · 5,585,304 MHC assays · 1,574 organisms
datasets.access: Open — portal, bulk downloads and public API
datasets.recommended_question: Does a population-HLA polytope rule beat a single-allele binder rule across organisms?
datasets.notes: The broadest labelled substrate. Assay heterogeneity is the main threat; stratify by assay type.

datasets.name: TESLA
datasets.labels: Experimentally validated immunogenic versus non-validated cancer neoepitopes
datasets.scale: Consortium benchmark · ~47% HLA-A*02:01 · accessed Nov 2025
datasets.access: Possible to get — Synapse login/registration required
datasets.recommended_question: Does a multi-feature within-patient rule beat binding-only on validated neoepitopes?
datasets.notes: The canonical external benchmark. HLA skew means allele-stratified claims are mandatory. Computational tools still show >50% false-positive rates on validated targets.

datasets.name: TANTIGEN 2.0
datasets.labels: 100% experimentally validated T-cell epitopes and neoepitopes with corrected HLA tags
datasets.scale: >1,000 T-cell epitopes and HLA ligands across 292+ tumour antigens
datasets.access: Open — web access, no commercial restrictions; bulk files by author request
datasets.recommended_question: Which shared tumour antigens are robustly presented across HLA backgrounds?
datasets.notes: Small but curated. Useful as a benchmark-only set when a larger discovery cohort is available.

datasets.name: dbPepNeo2.0 — high-confidence tier
datasets.labels: Immunogenic neoantigens validated by specific TCR recognition (Class I and II HC)
datasets.scale: Class I and II HC neoantigens plus TCR pairs across 71 HLA types
datasets.recommended_question: Do Class II HC neoantigens follow the same ranking rule as Class I?
datasets.notes: Small high-confidence confirmation set. Distinct from the MC/LC immunopeptidome tiers, which are unlabelled for recognition.

datasets.name: NEPdb — validated neopeptide dataset
datasets.labels: Experimentally T-cell validated positive neoantigens and non-immunogenic negative peptides
datasets.scale: Manually curated literature subset
datasets.recommended_question: Does a rule trained on CEDAR transfer to the NEPdb validated subset?
datasets.notes: The VND tier is labelled; the PND tier is predicted and must never be used as confirmation.

datasets.name: TSNAdb v2.0 — collected tier
datasets.labels: Curated experimentally validated neoantigens
datasets.scale: Integrated with CandrisDB cancer-driver links
datasets.recommended_question: Do predicted neoantigen tiers agree with the experimentally collected tier?
datasets.notes: The SNV/INDEL/fusion tiers are predictions, not labels. Do not pool them with the collected tier.

datasets.name: VDJdb
datasets.labels: Experimentally verified TCR CDR3–pMHC specificity pairs
datasets.scale: 59 HLA-I epitopes (45 independent) in the 2026 filtered benchmark
datasets.recommended_question: Does a public-TCR similarity rule beat exact CDR3 matching on held-out epitopes?
datasets.notes: Single β-chain entries vastly outnumber paired αβ chains; treat chain type as a stratifier.

datasets.name: McPAS-TCR
datasets.labels: Pathology-associated TCR–epitope binding pairs
datasets.scale: 70 HLA-I epitopes (31 independent) in the 2026 benchmark
datasets.access: Open — web file download only, no API
datasets.recommended_question: Does a TCR–pMHC model trained on VDJdb transfer to McPAS?
datasets.notes: Known HLA allele misannotations; never use as a primary confirmation set without re-curation.

datasets.name: ImmuneCODE
datasets.labels: MIRA antigen-specific TCR–pMHC binding pairs
datasets.scale: 86 HLA-I epitopes (84 independent) in the 2026 filtered CDR3 benchmark
datasets.recommended_question: Does a compact public-TCR signature generalise across donors and epitopes?
datasets.notes: Useful for TCR-binding benchmarks; SARS-CoV-2-specific, so transport to cancer is a separate claim.

datasets.name: 10x Genomics CD8+ / NetTCR 2.0 MIRA
datasets.labels: pMHC multimer UMI counts (>10 positive, ≤10 negative) and validated TCR–pMHC benchmarks
datasets.scale: 4-donor set: 19,906 unique positive CDR3–epitope pairs; NetTCR 2.0 MIRA: 192 HLA-A*02:01 samples
datasets.recommended_question: Do multimer UMI thresholds change the apparent TCR–epitope binding rate?
datasets.notes: Threshold choice is an outcome-defining decision; pre-register it.

datasets.name: RCSB PDB antibody–antigen and TCR complexes
datasets.labels: Solved crystal structures mapping B-cell epitope contact residues (≤4 Å) and TCR–pMHC interfaces
datasets.scale: Training and benchmark basis for BepiPred-3.0 and DiscoTope-3.0
datasets.recommended_question: Does a sequence-only B-cell epitope model recover structural contact residues?
datasets.notes: Structural contacts are labels of binding geometry, not necessarily immunogenicity.

datasets.name: dbPepNeo2.0 — MC/LC immunopeptidome tiers
datasets.labels: MS-detected peptides and HLA class I/II immunopeptidomes without TCR validation
datasets.scale: 28 MS immunopeptidomes · 251 Class I MC · 720,782 Class I LC · 121,507 Class II LC peptides
datasets.recommended_question: Which presented peptides are plausible immunogens before any T-cell assay?
datasets.notes: Presentation is not immunogenicity. This set can generate candidates but cannot confirm them.

datasets.name: SysteMHC Atlas
datasets.labels: MS raw files and MHC class I/II eluted-ligand identifications (no T-cell assays)
datasets.scale: Pan-cancer immunopeptidomics repository
datasets.recommended_question: Does the predictor recover eluted ligands better than a binding-only baseline?
datasets.notes: A presentation benchmark, not an immunogenicity confirmation set.

datasets.name: NEPdb — predicted neoepitopes
datasets.labels: Computational HLA-I binding predictions only (NetMHCpan 4.0, HLAthena)
datasets.scale: Derived from 16,745 shared pan-cancer somatic mutations
datasets.recommended_question: How much of the predicted landscape survives a real assay filter?
datasets.notes: Predicted labels are not labels. Using this as confirmation would certify a tautology.

datasets.name: TSNAdb v2.0 — SNV / INDEL / fusion tiers
datasets.labels: Predicted neoantigens (DeepHLApan, MHCflurry, NetMHCpan 4.0)
datasets.scale: Lung 52,801 · CRC 39,116 · bladder 21,070 · breast 18,238 SNV predictions
datasets.recommended_question: Which predicted neoantigens recur across tumour types and HLA backgrounds?
datasets.notes: Prediction tier only. Pair with the collected tier for any truth-based claim.

datasets.name: TCGA / TARGET / GENIE (GDC, cBioPortal)
datasets.labels: Matched tumour/normal WES/WGS, RNA-seq, culture models and clinical survival; no epitope labels
datasets.scale: TCGA 11,000 patients across 33 cancer types; GENIE-NKI 23 types, 42 sites; TARGET paediatric
datasets.access: Dual tier — open summaries; controlled access for raw GDC BAM/germline files
datasets.recommended_question: Which tumour types have enough expression and HLA background to support an epitope panel?
datasets.notes: Essential input layer. Never a confirmation set for immunogenicity.

datasets.name: CPTAC
datasets.labels: Quantitative MS proteomics of TCGA-linked cancer biospecimens
datasets.scale: Multi-tumour proteomic quantification for expression filtering
datasets.access: Open docs / cloud login — NCI Cancer Genomics Cloud
datasets.recommended_question: Does protein-level abundance change the prioritisation of predicted neoepitopes?
datasets.notes: Use to filter expression hypotheses, not to label immunogenicity.

datasets.name: OGRDB / VDJbase
datasets.labels: Germline V(D)J gene alleles and repertoire genomics
datasets.scale: Active 2026 Nucleic Acids Research update
datasets.access: Open — public web portals and APIs
datasets.recommended_question: Which germline alleles are absent from the reference and could bias TCR calls?
datasets.notes: Reference infrastructure, not an outcome dataset.

datasets.name: AlphaFoldDB
datasets.labels: Predicted 3D protein folds
datasets.scale: Full predicted proteome structures
datasets.recommended_question: Do predicted structures improve conformational B-cell epitope ranking?
datasets.notes: A model output, not an experimental measurement. Do not treat as ground truth.

datasets.name: Disease-specific autoimmune / viral cohorts
datasets.disease: Autoimmune (celiac, MS, T1D), chronic HBV, allergy
datasets.labels: Dedicated patient-level multi-omics cohorts were not documented in the reviewed indices
datasets.scale: Gap — typically controlled-access clinical consortia
datasets.recommended_question: What cohort would make an inverse-vaccine or functional-cure claim answerable?
datasets.notes: The sleeper gap. The report explicitly notes these cohorts were not documented; the power oracle should refuse claims built on proxies.
